title: Cell definition (cell.yaml) v0.3.0
description: A cell is a directory of configuration; cell.yaml says who the cell is, which streams it records, which lexostatuses it offers, and which grams an empty chronicle starts with (initial_state). A cell records, stores and reduces; who acts follows from the actor's policy and the deployment (RFC-047). Paths are relative to the directory of cell.yaml.

id.description: The name of the cell. The runtime serves it under /cells/<id>/api/ and writes its chronicle to DATA_DIR/<id>/.

recording_actor.description: The actor that records in this cell. Every stream of the cell has this recording_actor.

streams.description: Stream definitions (stream.json): a file or a directory of files.

lexostatuses.description: The file with the lexostatus definitions (lexostatus.json).

initial_state.description: A JSONL file with grams that the cell puts into an empty chronicle on startup. Each line has stream, name, effective_at, provenance: initial_state and fields, and where needed id and refers_to (a reference to another gram of the initial state); the rest follows from the stream. Without an id, the cell assigns one.
